verdict.rationale: Vestd's share-issuance flow lets an admin authorise a pool and 'instantly distribute the equity to one or more recipients', which is a documented multi-recipient issuance rather than one-at-a-time entry. Its 'Migrate to Vestd' offering covers digitising or moving an existing scheme, which implies bringing over historical holdings. Neither is documented as a true bulk upload or batch-import mechanism. Missing for 10: a documented bulk/CSV upload of grants or historical transactions, evidence of batch option grants (not just share distribution), detail on how migration imports historical transactions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
